text_block_list.text:
A massive roar of cheers and applause 
rained down upon Taiki Shuttle for her 
glorious victory...!

Holding off Silence Suzuka, the strongest 
Umamusume active today, Taiki Shuttle 
claimed victory in three sprint GⅠ races, 
putting her star power on full display.

Having given it her all, her only 
remaining goal... was to "Become Umamusume 
of the Year!" —Nothing more, nothing less.
